dictionary.the45: BT810's hyperbolic polar pairs {L, L^perp} of PG(3,3) = the 45 tritangent planes
dictionary.support: L u L^perp, which is 8 points because a nondegenerate L is disjoint from L^perp

theIdentification.statement: two tritangent planes are GQ(4,2)-collinear iff their supports are disjoint iff the four hyperbolic lines L, L^perp, M, M^perp are the opposite regulus of an all-isotropic regulus of W(3,3)

gramIdentitiesReproduced.reading: the sentinel plane's cross-incidence is the point / polar-pair incidence of PG(3,3), built here with no reference to any code

consequences.forTheCode: the 45 minimum words are the tritangent planes; the 216 five-circuits are the 5-element sets of pairwise regulus-unrelated tritangent planes; and im(C) = 1+20+24 is the eigenspace decomposition of SRG(45,12,3,3), eigenvalues 12, 3, -3
consequences.forTheObstruction: the 270 reguli that stop a single Clifford orbit blocking at depth 3 are the 270 disjoint pairs of minimum-weight words of a [40,15,8] code
consequences.headline: the depth-3 blocking obstruction and the sentinel code's minimum-weight shell are the same 270 objects

priorArt.BT810: W33-Theory: the 40 + 90 split, the fixed-point-free polarity, the 45 polar pairs as tritangent planes, the Schlafli dictionary
priorArt.sentinelPackets: Holotrade 610b99e: the [40,15,8] code, B, the shell metric, the 216 circuits, and the bicolour 1+15+20+24
priorArt.ebaec5a: the q-generalization: the graph is a q = 3 coincidence
priorArt.classical: 45 tritangent planes and 27 lines form GQ(4,2)
priorArt.whatIsNew: only the identification -- that the two 45-sets coincide, that the two 270-sets coincide AS SETS, and that both Gram identities follow from the geometry alone

boundary: an identification of finite structures, verified by set equality and by reproducing both Gram identities. It says nothing about the code's use for error correction and nothing about hardware. tau_2 is untouched and stays open in [111, 115]
